messages:
maria: Quick check — onboarding llama3-mini-v1 weights for serving. Need confirmation on three things before canary: weights / manifest location, any tokenizer quirks we should know about, and that config/schema passes rwd-validate-config. Also: where are the golden prompts for regression eval and a quick tool-calling smoke test I can run?

devon: weights are uploaded to s3: s3://rw-model-artifacts/llama3/llama3-mini-v1/weights-2026-03-15.tar.gz (md5: 9f8b7a3d). Manifest is next to it: s3://rw-model-artifacts/llama3/llama3-mini-v1/manifest.json.

jonathan: tokenizer note — training data had some non-breaking spaces and soft hyphens. The default tokenizer config strips NBSPs which caused mismatches in golden outputs. Quick fix: set `preserve_whitespace: true` in tokenizer config or run `python tools/normalize_whitespace.py` on the vocab.

alyssa: For config validation run: `rwd-validate-config --model-config model_configs/llama3-mini-v1.json` — expected output: 
```
OK: schema v2
WARN: kv_cache_size auto-assigned (monitor after warmup)
PASS: tokenizer compatibility check
```
If you see "FAIL: tokenizer mismatch" run jonathan's normalization first.

maria: thanks — can you paste the minimal `model_configs/llama3-mini-v1.json` snippet we should point the validator at?

devon: paste below — minimal fields we need: 
```
{
  "model_name": "llama3-mini-v1",
  "weights_path": "s3://rw-model-artifacts/llama3/llama3-mini-v1/weights-2026-03-15.tar.gz",
  "tokenizer": "byte-level-bpe",
  "max_seq_len": 2048,
  "quantization": "int8",
  "serve": {
    "batching": { "max_batch_size": 32, "latency_slo_ms": 120 }
  }
}
```

jonathan: Also add this tokenizer snippet if you want to preserve spaces: 
```
"tokenizer_opts": { "preserve_whitespace": true, "normalize_nfkc": true }
```

alyssa: Golden prompts are in the repo under `evals/goldsets/llama3-mini-v1/golden_prompts.jsonl`. They include structured-output cases and tool-calling prompts. For toolcall smoke: run `pytest -q tests/evals/test_toolcalls.py::test_llama3_toolcall_smoke -k mini` — should finish in ~30s against local runner.

maria: great — I'll run the validator + smoke tests. Tentative plan: block canary until smoke and one regression pass. @devon please don't start canary until I say go. :pray:

devon: ack. holding canary. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI: lint passed, unit tests (fast) passed for branch `onboard/llama3-mini-v1` — 6 checks green.

maria: ran validator locally — output shows WARN about kv_cache auto-assign. alyssa, is that expected?

alyssa: yes, kv cache is auto-picked for now. We'll monitor hit-rate and adjust `kv_cache_size` in the rollout if we see degraded tail latency. Leave the WARN for the canary.

maria: ran toolcall smoke: one failure (external-http-tool) — looks like the container env needs `ALLOW_OUTBOUND_HTTP=true` for the smoke harness. Quick fix?: set `TEST_NETWORK=host` in the docker run for the smoke job.

jonathan: that's known — smoke harness defaults to blocked egress. For local quick smoke set `ALLOW_OUTBOUND_HTTP=true pytest ...` or use `--network=host` in docker. We'll keep the production CI blocked.

maria: ok will rerun with ALLOW_OUTBOUND_HTTP and re-check golden outputs. If all green I'll post back and we can start a canary.

deploy-bot: Canary plan pending — no deploys started (awaiting human ok).

maria: update: re-ran with ALLOW_OUTBOUND_HTTP, all smoke tests passed, validator OK (same kv cache WARN). Ran 50 examples from golden_prompts — 2 structured-output regressions (field ordering changed). Filed ticket RW-2319 with examples. Holding on canary until we get deterministic structured-output ordering or add post-processor to mask ordering diffs.

devon: thanks — please add the failing examples to the canary blockers list in the ticket and tag me. I can patch post-processor quickly if we decide to mask ordering.

maria: added examples + tagged you. Next steps: jonathan to publish tokenizer normalization script to CI, alyssa to add post-processor option to regression harness, devon to stand by for canary. I'll re-run full goldset once both are in.

jonathan: will open PR for normalize_whitespace.py and add a small unit test. ETA EOD.

alyssa: will add `--mask-ordering` opt to `evals/run_regression.py` and a note in runbook: <https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding#ordering-mask>. ETA tomorrow morning.

maria: perfect — thanks team. I'll update the ticket and ping when ready to promote. :rocket:
